# Rules: X
company.md wins. 
When helping another bot with a job, also read rules/<that-bot>.md.
```yaml
rules:
  - id: A-1
    value: "Daily stop for this bot."
    date: YYYY-MM-DD (example)
    source_type: team_setting
    source: fixture
    supersedes: []
    owner: T
    tightens: STOP-DAY-1
    limit: -15
```
